org_constraint: Deployment SSO role has org-level explicit DENY on CloudTrail (CreateTrail+DescribeTrails), kms:CreateKey, and likely GuardDuty. These are centrally managed at org level. CloudTrail disabled locally via observability/terraform.tfvars (enable_cloudtrail=false). Detective controls and CMK absence scored Partial (org-managed, unverifiable statically), NOT Missing; no finding penalizes the disabling.

computation.note: global_score = 1061.4 / 12.8 = 82.92 -> 83. Uncapped maturity 4 (75-89). Capped to 2/5 by open Critical TF-F1.

consolidated_critical_high.title: Shared S3 Terraform state without locking
Permanent worker errors silently dropped (no DLQ, no metric)
No CI/CD pipeline; tests not enforced as release gate
No linter/formatter configured nor CI quality gate

roadmap.action: Enable use_lockfile=true + required_version>=1.10.0 on the 7 s3 backends (releases the global maturity cap -> 4/5).
Enable function_response_types=[ReportBatchItemFailures] (or explicit DLQ send) + PermanentFailures EMF metric.
Pin Python deps (== + hashes), pin base image by digest, enable ECR scan_on_push.
Add prevent_destroy on state bucket, idempotency table, secrets.
Add monthly aws_budgets_budget (80/100% thresholds) notifying the existing SNS alarm topic.
Restore default_tags in the security module (obsolete CMK workaround).
CI/CD pipeline: terraform fmt/validate/plan + ruff + mypy + pytest --cov gate + dep/IaC scanning + gated apply. Addresses OPS-F1, MNT-F1, TF-F5, SEC-F4.
Document DR/RTO/RPO + assumed mono-region for POC (S); for prod PITR + IaC-driven multi-region redeploy (L).
Bound tarball size and stream extraction (stop at read caps) for constant memory footprint.
Define a capacity model (runs/h) tying worker concurrency to granted Bedrock TPS; add SLO + load test.
